bio: Overview My research investigates structural and cultural change in organizations, including the dynamics of hiring, M&A, and reorganizations. My work employs a variety of computational methods, including simulations, natural language processing, and machine learning. Keywords: Organizational Culture ; Organizational Theory ; Computational Social Science ; Cultural Change ; Mergers and Acquisitions
